title: I-050 embedding encryption and CharacterRepository wiring
clauseOfficialized: Embeddings are encrypted at rest (HMAC-SHA256 keystream and MAC) and decrypt back to plaintext; a wrong key is EMBEDDING_MAC_MISMATCH; archive/log still carry only ids and traces. CharacterRepository.requestVoiceClone / dispatch(voiceClone) checks cloningAllowed, voice rights, and consent, then fails closed as CLONE_INFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE without incrementing successful executions or storing an embedding. Missing consent is CONSENT_REQUIRED, not FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
whyNotAlreadyOfficial: Increment 2.14 left embedding encryption and CharacterRepository.voiceClone as FEATURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED.
rowsStillOpenOnI050: Real clone inference (FakeCloneBackend stays CLONE_INFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE; no weights downloaded)
Hardware HSM or production key custody (EmbeddingCipher is a software sealed box)
An approval or pack flag still does not represent a permission grant
preexistingI036Fts5Note: Two frozen I-036 assertions that fts5Enabled is false already fail at 80caa6f on this host; not rewritten; not a 2.20 regression.
